_README: RULE 1: Never publish a competitor's pricing from memory. Every competitor cell must be sourced from that broker's own published tariff page on a stated date.
RULE 2: Fill 'value' only after someone has opened the 'source' URL and copied the figure. Set 'checkedOn' to that date.
RULE 3: Null values render as 'Verify on broker site' with a link. That is an acceptable, honest state to ship in.
RULE 4: No 'winner', no 'best broker', no highlighting Trade Grow's column. The table is a research aid, not an ad.
disclaimer: Brokerage and charges change frequently. Always verify the latest pricing directly with the respective broker before deciding. criteria.label: Account Opening Charge
criteria.note: One-time charge to open the trading and demat account.

criteria.label: Demat AMC
criteria.note: Annual maintenance charge on the demat account.

criteria.label: DP Charges (on delivery sell)
criteria.note: Charged per scrip per day by the depository and the DP.

criteria.label: Statutory Charges (STT, GST, Stamp Duty, Exchange, SEBI)
criteria.note: Identical across all brokers. These are set by the Government, Exchanges and SEBI, not by the broker.

criteria.label: Trading Platforms
criteria.note: Mobile app, web terminal, desktop terminal.

criteria.label: Product Availability
criteria.note: Equity, F&O, Currency, Commodity, Mutual Funds, IPO, Bonds.

criteria.label: Other Charges (call & trade, auto square-off, payment gateway)

howToCompare: Compare total cost per trade, not just brokerage. A nil-brokerage plan still carries statutory charges.
Check the charges that match how you actually trade. Delivery investors care about DP charges and AMC; intraday traders care about per-order brokerage.
Read the conditions attached to any promotional pricing: which segments, for how long, and what the rate becomes afterwards.
Check platform stability and support responsiveness, not only price. The cheapest platform is expensive if you cannot exit a position.
Verify every broker's SEBI registration and exchange membership independently before opening an account with any of them, including us.
